annotations.annotation_text: The nocturnal oneiric dimension (sleep): Joyce's exploration of the sleeping body, sensory deprivation, auditory distortions, and the somatic language of the collective unconscious.
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish
Freud, Sigmund. The Interpretation of Dreams. https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/4349

annotations.annotation_text: Liturgical or ecclesiastical allusion (Amen): weaving Catholic ritual, Latin prayers, and sacramental language into the domestic nighttime dream.
sources: Frazer, Sir James George. Folk-Lore in the Old Testament. https://archive.org/details/folkloreinoldtes01frazuoft
